purpose: Model CPN corridor economics vs SWIFT/ACH/SEPA/card/RTP for cross-border USD flows. Quantifies per-payment cost, FX spread, settlement time, and 3-year NPV. Industry benchmarks: WorldBank Q4 2024 (SWIFT 5.5% remittance), Nacha 2024 (ACH). CPN fee $0.01 user-adjustable estimate.
